hooks.name: server_tick_timed
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no tick timing event; spark's tick monitor and profiler)

rust_summary: each server tick's wall and CPU time with its spans (`native_server_tick_timed`, `TickSpan`), a shared switch for the spans (`native_spans`), and mob costs a mod samples apart from performance reports (`native_mob_cost_sampling`, `native_take_mob_costs`, `NativeMobCost`).
doc_summary: `native_server_tick_timed(wall_ms, cpu_ms, spans)` after each server tick pass while spans are recorded (always on a dedicated server; elsewhere after `native_spans(true)`), and mob costs by level and type a mod samples apart from `horizon-report` (`native_mob_cost_sampling(on)`, `native_take_mob_costs()`). Bundles need "hooks": @API:server_tick_timed@.
